descriptions.w3d_created_message_init_800c1620: Initialises a 'LogicEntity.Created' message with its resolved identifier and a copied 32-bit value.
descriptions.w3d_low_gravity_type_800c16e4: Returns the global type record of the low-gravity logic class.
descriptions.w3d_low_gravity_unlink_800c16f0: Removes a low-gravity entity from its type's instance list and decrements the instance count.
descriptions.w3d_low_gravity_create_800c1734: Allocates and constructs a low-gravity entity, then registers it in its type's instance list.
descriptions.w3d_low_gravity_release_800c1794: Drops one reference to a low-gravity entity; at zero it unlinks and deletes the entity.
descriptions.w3d_low_gravity_retain_800c17f0: Adds one reference to a low-gravity entity and returns the previous count.
descriptions.w3d_low_gravity_construct_800c1808: Constructor for the low-gravity entity: runs the actor base constructor and clears its slots.
descriptions.w3d_low_gravity_destroy_800c1858: Destructor for the low-gravity entity: releases two held subscriptions and runs the actor base destructor.
descriptions.w3d_low_gravity_handle_800c18d4: Message handler for the low-gravity entity: subscribes on attach, removes itself on weapon delete and activates on fire.
descriptions.w3d_low_gravity_kind_800c19a0: Returns -1, apparently the default kind value for this class.
descriptions.w3d_low_gravity_subscribe_800c19a8: Subscribes the low-gravity entity to the weapon-delete and fire-pressed messages.
descriptions.w3d_low_gravity_detach_800c1a10: Empty detach hook of the low-gravity entity.
descriptions.w3d_low_gravity_position_800c1b20: Returns the position of the actor that owns the low-gravity entity.
descriptions.w3d_logic_b_type_800c1c5c: Returns the global type record of a logic class that registers many other classes when attached.
descriptions.w3d_logic_b_unlink_800c1c68: Removes an entity of this logic class from its instance list and decrements the instance count.
descriptions.w3d_logic_b_create_800c1cac: Allocates and constructs an entity of this logic class, then registers it in its instance list.
descriptions.w3d_logic_b_release_800c1d0c: Drops one reference to an entity of this logic class; at zero it unlinks and deletes the entity.
descriptions.w3d_logic_b_retain_800c1d68: Adds one reference to an entity of this logic class and returns the previous count.
descriptions.w3d_logic_b_construct_800c1d80: Constructor: runs the actor base constructor, clears three slots and records the object as the current instance.
descriptions.w3d_logic_b_destroy_800c1dd0: Destructor: clears the current-instance pointer, releases three held objects and runs the actor base destructor.
descriptions.w3d_logic_b_handle_800c1e70: Message handler: performs setup on attach and the detach hook on detach, otherwise defers to the actor base handler.
descriptions.w3d_logic_b_kind_800c1ef8: Returns -1, apparently the default kind value for this class.
descriptions.w3d_logic_b_attach_800c1f00: Creates a configured object, stores it in the game state, then creates and registers twelve more class instances.
descriptions.w3d_logic_b_detach_800c2140: Empty detach hook of this logic class.
descriptions.w3d_logic_c_type_800c21d0: Returns the global type record of a small logic class.
descriptions.w3d_logic_c_unlink_800c21dc: Removes an entity of this logic class from its instance list and decrements the instance count.
descriptions.w3d_logic_c_create_800c2220: Allocates and constructs an entity of this logic class, then registers it in its instance list.
descriptions.w3d_logic_c_release_800c2280: Drops one reference to an entity of this logic class; at zero it unlinks and deletes the entity.
descriptions.w3d_logic_c_retain_800c22dc: Adds one reference to an entity of this logic class and returns the previous count.
descriptions.w3d_logic_c_construct_800c22f4: Constructor: runs the logic base constructor and clears one held slot.
descriptions.w3d_logic_c_destroy_800c2338: Destructor: releases one held object and runs the logic base destructor.
descriptions.w3d_logic_c_handle_800c2398: Message handler: on attach runs the base handler then the empty attach hook; otherwise defers to the base handler.
descriptions.w3d_logic_c_kind_800c23fc: Returns -1, apparently the default kind value for this class.
descriptions.w3d_logic_c_attach_800c2404: Empty attach hook of this logic class.
